- Purpose of this folder is to handle Software Requirement Specifications with the help of Claude
- Files:
    * _basicRequirementsVxx.md_   Write down the coarse requirements on the newswitch softare. ***HUMANS ONLY***. DO NOT EDIT WITH AI. Make sure, the points you are adding here are rather structured. Always start new version. Claude should find differences to the olds and than update the real SRS
    * _InitReview.md_ Claudes Summary of newswitch V0.1. This should not be changed as it is the initial hook for Claude
    * _SRS_Standards.md_ Claudes research result for standards of SRS docs
    * _SRS_VX.md_ Claudes derived SRS from basicRequirements, the exiting package and general SW standards
    * _MVP_Tasks.md_  Tasks to be done for the minimum viable product
    * _openPoints.md_ Claudes unanswered questions
    * _InvariantMatrix_ Claudes result for the invariant matrix of the software in order to ensure functionality
    * _TODOS.md_ Todo list for Claude. ***HUMANS ONLY*** Fill here tasks for claude that are requried to be done. Delete the tasks, once they are done

- Procedure:
    * Make a new Version of basicRequirements.md
    * Let Claude compare your new version and the latest version
    * In addition make Claude read the InitReview.md, the OpenPoints, and the SRS_STANDARD.m
    * let it update the SRS_Vxx.md with new versioning. Unclearities it should dump to open points
